title: SCHC Rule 255 accepts malformed data instead of validated full IPv6 packets
description: Python and Rust compressors/decoders blindly wrap or return arbitrary Rule 255 bytes, including short/non-v6 packets, payload-length mismatches and UDP checksum zero. Require a validated full IPv6 packet (minimum header, v6 nibble, exact payload length, supported header policy, UDP exact length and nonzero valid checksum); replace stale zero-checksum vector and add shared malformed boundaries.
notes: Final Python security review reproduced an additional registry path: Rule255 is installed as a zero-field generic Rule, so codec.decompress accepts bare b'\xff' as Rule255 and rejects valid b'\xff'+IPv6 as excess residue. Generic codec/context must dispatch Rule255 to the specialized validated implementation or exclude it from generic RULES.
